criteria: Answers the requested investor question with usable evidence
Distinguishes missing retrieval from genuine corpus limits
assessment.gate: At least 5 of 7 substantive questions Useful, remaining gaps explicitly reported; no material misleading evidence presentation; Q08 must not imply source-grounded price prediction. Partial queries and irrelevant extra results do not automatically fail.
separate: candidate coverage observed, not exhaustive recall without full annotations
assessment.comparison: Same frozen questions and final candidate/block settings for lexical baseline and hybrid. Blind A/B labels for GPT-6. No tuning on scores or rerun of old benchmark.
assessment.judgment_limit: GPT-6 judges provided originals, not exhaustive full-corpus absence; question familiarity means no generalization claim.
